name: Meidaimae
tagline: Shinjuku in 10 minutes and Shibuya in 13 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Keio run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 35 minutes to Otemachi, 10 minutes to Shinjuku, 13 minutes to Shibuya and 39 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 41.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 41.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 36.9 m to 48.3 m, a difference of 11.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 13 clinics and 7 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 吉川内科小児科病院, about 14 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is うめとぴあ, about 21 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Keio Line and Keio Inokashira Line. Both lines are run by Keio, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Keio Line runs at 145% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 下高井戸→明大前, which includes this station. Keio Inokashira Line runs at 125% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池ノ上→駒場東大前, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Higashi-Matsubara is ahead on quiet, but Meidaimae is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Meidaimae. Higashi-Matsubara has only the Keio Inokashira Line, so Meidaimae is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Higashi-Matsubara takes 7 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Higashi-Matsubara comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Daitabashi is ahead on quiet, but Meidaimae is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Meidaimae. Daitabashi has only the Keio Line, so Meidaimae is the better connected. To Shibuya, for instance, Daitabashi takes 5 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥8,000 more at Daitabashi.

goodFor: People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
甲州街道 (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
